g.text: Registration is a race. It should be a lottery.
First come, first served rewards the fastest connection. Even Odds spreads applications over a window and draws them fairly.
Fairfax County: the camp platform "crashed under the strain of first-day registrations" (FFXnow, 2025) · Bend, OR: about 1,200 people in the
waiting room before 6 a.m. (2026) · Chicago: camps sold out within minutes (2026) · Richmond: swim sign-up "like Hunger Games"
Applying early gives no advantage · ranking your true favourite first never hurts (round 1) · the database refuses an oversold seat · the
result can be checked by anyone
